title: Phishing emails in practice
intro: Spot a fake email at first glance. Decide what you would do in each moment from this module's lessons.

decisions.title: September payslip
decisions.prompt: Read the sender address letter by letter. What do you do with this e-mail?

artifact.subject: September payslip
body: Your payslip is ready. If you do not confirm within 24 hours, the payment will be stopped.

decisions.explain: The address has a capital I instead of a small l: a look-alike domain.

decisions.title: Sign-in page from the link
decisions.prompt: The link opened this sign-in page. Read the address to the end. What do you do?

artifact.title: Xidmət Agentliyi
body: Xidmət Agentliyi. Sign in to see your payslip.

decisions.explain: The familiar name in front is decoration; the real domain was hesab-yoxla.info.

decisions.title: Call from OfisTəchizat MMC

artifact.name: OfisTəchizat MMC
body: Hello, Gunel Aliyeva from OfisTəchizat. Did you get our email? Please pay the September invoice to the new account today.

options.label: I will check on the contract number

decisions.explain: The email and the call can come from the same scammer. Check through another channel.

decisions.title: Tomorrow's meeting

artifact.subject: Tomorrow's meeting
body: See you tomorrow at 10:00 in room 3. The agenda is in yesterday's email.

decisions.explain: A known colleague, the right address, no link and no request. A normal work email.

decisions.title: Message from UlduzBank

artifact.name: UlduzBank
body: UlduzBank: Your card has been blocked. To unblock it, sign in: https://ulduzbank-az.info/kart

decisions.explain: The sender name can be faked, and the link is not the bank's site. If in doubt, call the number on the back of your card.
